### Private QA source setup

Configure the dedicated QA spreadsheet ID created by the scaffold fixture. This seeder checks each tab is empty, then uses native Google Sheets append to write all documented headers and synthetic business records. Dates are shifted together at the start of the run so upcoming/expired-source rules can be tested against the current time.

Do not point this at a production workbook. Do not rerun after the source workflows have written delivery evidence. If seeding stops partway through, generate a narrowed fixture for the unseeded days rather than clearing or overwriting existing tabs. No paid render, email, public sharing, or social publication is configured.
